title: CONCORD-Rec: Catalog-Conditioned Modality Utility for Semantic-ID Diffusion Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. translated_title: CONCORD-Rec：面向语义ID扩散推荐的目录条件化模态效用方法
translated_abstract: 基于离散语义标识符的多模态生成式推荐需要区分那些仅仅改变token预测的历史模态与真正降低目录级歧义的模态。当视听、视觉或文本流缺失、退化或语义冲突时，均匀融合和无约束的token门控会在迭代去噪步骤中传播误导性内容。我们提出CONCORD-Rec，一种由反事实目录划分效用监督的可靠性条件化离散扩散推荐器。给定固定的分词器和部分掩码的SID状态，CONCORD-Rec在精确的可行目录支持上评估折外教师联盟，并在每个未解析位置上跨目标代码划分聚合物品后验分布。该方法并非直接蒸馏原始token概率，而是利用由此产生的反事实损失差异来监督可用性掩码的token门控（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: CONCORD-Rec提出了一种由反事实目录划分效用监督的可靠性条件化离散扩散推荐框架，能够区分真正降低目录级歧义的模态，从而避免缺失或冲突模态的误导性信息在语义ID去噪过程中传播。
en_tdlr: CONCORD-Rec proposes a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility, distinguishing modalities that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity to prevent misleading information from propagating during semantic-ID denoising.
